prompts.name: 00_extended_clean_master
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / panorama outpainting.
Edit the supplied approved pixel-art Marseille Hangar J4 quay game background into a CLEAN EXTENDED BACKGROUND PLATE for later layer extraction. The reference is the center section, not just loose inspiration. Preserve its actual visual identity, dark fine pixel art, sunset palette, level quay geometry and side-on view.
Output one extremely wide horizontal panoramic strip, desired aspect ratio 6.375:1 (5484 x 860), three equal virtual screen-width sections: NEW LEFT EXTENSION | ORIGINAL CENTER | NEW RIGHT EXTENSION. No gutters, borders, labels or visible divisions. Keep the original camera zoom/object scale in the CENTER THIRD and extend the world one original screen width to each side, not a zoomed-out reimagining.
CENTER: preserve recognizable Fort Saint-Jean across the bay, same sky red-orange/purple, same sea, same straight flat cracked concrete pier. REMOVE all cars, ALL shipping containers, the wrecked boat AND smoke plume, the left-edge crane tower, loose crates/barrels, foreground bollards/chains, and all manhole covers. Reconstruct underlying scenery convincingly without any holes. These objects will be separate sprites. Preserve concrete cracks, occasional oil puddles and faded yellow ground lines, original horizontal rear quay at 54% image height and front quay face beginning at 88%. Sea horizon approximately 34% down; buildings above that.
LEFT EXTENSION: uninterrupted continuation of the same wide cracked concrete quay, same ground plane, yellow markings and subdued oil stains; behind is more teal harbor and distant industrial Marseille quayside with small cranes and warehouses. Sky gets dusty purple toward left. No foreground objects blocking walkable floor.
RIGHT EXTENSION: uninterrupted continuation of same quay, ground height, faint guide lines; bay behind opens toward low coastal hills and small distant port structures under warm sunset. Do not add another sun or duplicate Fort Saint-Jean.
INVARIANTS: all three sections share perfectly continuous straight quay edges, waterline, pixel scale and lighting. Original sun appears only once in center third toward its right side. MuCEM absent. Floor spans bottom 46% of full image uniformly. No trucks, cars, containers, people, monsters, floating objects, text, interface or watermarks. No perspectival road vanishing into depth: this is a long horizontal side-scrolling brawler stage. No blur or glossy 3D, preserve crisp deliberate small pixel clusters. This is one continuous background, no collage.

prompts.name: left_clean
prompts.prompt: Use case: panorama extension. Input image is the CENTER panel of a game stage. Produce ONLY a NEW ADJACENT panel, same canvas aspect ratio 2002:786 and same resolution, camera elevation, pixel scale and exposure. Match crisp dark detailed pixel art. Quay rear edge y=440/786; skyline/water horizon y=298/786; foreground quay face top y=688/786. Ground is broad cracked concrete with faint horizontal yellow guide markings and sparse dark oil puddles. Straight horizontal quay runs across the entire panel. Do not show any cars, containers, boats, smoke, manholes, people, crates, barrels or foreground cranes; those are independent sprites. No MuCEM, no labels, no text. Never replicate the central fort, sun, or central landmarks. This is one continuation image, not a triptych. All edges continue with sky, distant coast, water, concrete and the front quay wall at corresponding heights. Generate the LEFT extension: this image's RIGHT EDGE joins the reference LEFT EDGE. Continue the low industrial waterfront, small distant cranes and warehouses across the bay. Sky transitions gradually toward muted purple and subdued red at far left; sunset highlights come from offscreen right. Do not copy the center reference composition. Make genuinely new scenery: distant dockside sheds and a few small port cranes, behind the continuous empty foreground combat quay.
